title: Implement durable signal intake ledger
description: Add application-owned intake ledger (new SQLite store or shared LibSQL) per docs/mastra-signals.md: normalize envelope, validate category payloads, resolve workspaceId/conversationId from trusted server context and task-store correlation, insert before dispatch, return existing receipt on duplicate.
why: MAST-45 design requires accept-before-dispatch with producer dedupe; in-memory Mastra queues alone lose ingress on crash.

acceptance.text: SQLite ledger stores validated IntakeEnvelope rows with unique (producer, dedupeKey)
integration test proves duplicate accept is idempotent
